blocks.text: @GoogleDeepMind 在六周内发布了他们的第三款新模型。Gemini 4 Hydrogen 引入了 xhigh 推理级别，在 Artificial Analysis 智能指数上得分 54，在视觉推理和抗幻觉方面表现突出。这使其落后 Claude Sonnet 5.5（max）和 GPT-6.1 Sol（max）1 分，成本约为 Sonnet 的 32%，但约为 GPT-6.1 Sol 的 2.5 倍。在 high 推理下，Gemini 4 Hydrogen 的智能水平与 Gemini 4 Argon 相当，而每任务成本约为其 19%

inlines.text: @GoogleDeepMind 在六周内发布了他们的第三款新模型。Gemini 4 Hydrogen 引入了 xhigh 推理级别，在 Artificial Analysis 智能指数上得分 54，在视觉推理和抗幻觉方面表现突出。这使其落后 Claude Sonnet 5.5（max）和 GPT-6.1 Sol（max）1 分，成本约为 Sonnet 的 32%，但约为 GPT-6.1 Sol 的 2.5 倍。在 high 推理下，Gemini 4 Hydrogen 的智能水平与 Gemini 4 Argon 相当，而每任务成本约为其 19%
要点：

新的 xhigh 推理级别在智能指数上得分 54：xhigh 是 Gemini 模型上首个高于 high 的推理级别，使 Hydrogen 落后 Claude Sonnet 5.5（max）和 GPT-6.1 Sol（max）1 分，领先 Gemini 4 Argon（high）4 分。在默认（high）推理下，Gemini 4 Hydrogen 得分 51，略低于 GPT-6.1 Sol（xhigh，52）和 Claude Opus 5.5（high，52）

视觉推理、演示和抗幻觉能力强：在 GDP.pdf 这一长文档视觉推理基准上，它在 medium 推理下全通过率达到 33%，为该基准并列第一。在 AA-Omniscience 上，Hydrogen 的幻觉率为 8%，是有记录以来最低之一，而 Claude Sonnet 5.5（max）为 43%，GPT-6.1 Sol（max）为 52%。在 AA-Briefcase 这一智能体知识工作评估中，评分者认为 Hydrogen 的演示优于其他 Gemini 模型，包括 Carbon

在智能体终端任务上较弱：Hydrogen 在 Terminal-Bench 4.0 上得分 54%，在 Terminal-Bench-Science 0.1 上得分 50%，这两项涵盖终端中的智能体编程和科研工作流。Claude Sonnet 5.5（max）得分 64% 和 53%，GPT-6.1 Sol（max）得分 56% 和 58%。xhigh 推理对科学任务有帮助，将 Terminal-Bench-Science 从 high 下的 41% 提升至 50%，但对 Terminal-Bench 4.0 没有影响（两者均为 54%）。科学得分在各领域间较为均衡，从地球科学的 46% 到物理科学的 53%

相对其智能水平成本较低，但 xhigh 下 token 用量高：Hydrogen 定价为每百万输入/输出 token 1.50/7.50 美元。在 xhigh 下，其每任务成本约为 Claude Sonnet 5.5（max）的 32%，智能水平接近，但约为 GPT-6.1 Sol（max）的 2.5 倍。与 high 相比，xhigh 的输出 token 几乎翻倍，换来智能提升 3 分，每任务成本从 xhigh 的 3.16 美元降至 high 的 1.87 美元。medium（0.80 美元）和 low（0.29 美元）成本更低，但智能指数得分分别为 41 和 27
在每任务时间与智能的帕累托前沿上：Gemini 4 Hydrogen 的输出速度约为每秒 200 个输出 token。在 high、medium 和 low 推理强度下，Gemini 4 Hydrogen 位于每任务时间与智能的帕累托前沿上，意味着没有模型同时具备更高智能和更低每任务时间
关键模型细节：
上下文窗口：100 万 token
多模态：文本、图像、视频和语音输入，文本输出
推理强度：Gemini 4 Hydrogen 提供四个推理级别（low、medium、high 和 xhigh），其中 xhigh 为本次发布新增
定价：每 100 万输入/输出 token 1.50/7.50 美元。缓存输入 token 享受 95% 折扣（0.075 美元）
祝贺 @GoogleDeepMind 团队发布！

inlines.text: @GoogleDeepMind has released their third new model in six weeks. Gemini 4 Hydrogen introduces an xhigh reasoning level and scores 54 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, with strengths in visual reasoning and non-hallucination. This places it 1 point behind Claude Sonnet 5.5 (max) and GPT-6.1 Sol (max), at ~32% of Sonnet’s cost but ~2.5x that of GPT-6.1 Sol. With high reasoning, Gemini 4 Hydrogen matches the Intelligence of Gemini 4 Argon for ~19% of the Cost per Task
Key takeaways:

The new xhigh reasoning level scores 54 on the Intelligence Index: xhigh is the first reasoning level above high on a Gemini model, and puts Hydrogen 1 point below Claude Sonnet 5.5 (max) and GPT-6.1 Sol (max), and 4 points ahead of Gemini 4 Argon (high). With default (high) reasoning, Gemini 4 Hydrogen scores 51, just behind GPT-6.1 Sol (xhigh, 52) and Claude Opus 5.5 (high, 52)

Strong visual reasoning, presentation and non-hallucination: On GDP.pdf, a visual reasoning benchmark over long documents, it scores 33% all-pass on medium reasoning, the tied #1 score on the benchmark. On AA-Omniscience, Hydrogen has one of the lowest hallucination rates recorded at 8%, compared with 43% for Claude Sonnet 5.5 (max) and 52% for GPT-6.1 Sol (max). On AA-Briefcase, our agentic knowledge work evaluation, graders rate Hydrogen's presentation above other Gemini models, including Carbon

Weaker on agentic terminal work: Hydrogen scores 54% on Terminal-Bench 4.0 and 50% on Terminal-Bench-Science 0.1, covering agentic coding and scientific research workflows in the terminal. Claude Sonnet 5.5 (max) scores 64% and 53%, and GPT-6.1 Sol (max) scores 56% and 58%. xhigh reasoning helps on the science tasks, lifting Terminal-Bench-Science from 41% at high to 50%, but makes no difference on Terminal-Bench 4.0 (54% at both). Science scores are even across domains, from 46% in earth sciences to 53% in physical sciences

Low cost for its intelligence, with high token use at xhigh: Hydrogen is priced at $1.50/$7.50 per million input/output tokens. At xhigh it costs ~32% as much per task as Claude Sonnet 5.5 (max) for near-equal intelligence, but ~2.5x as much as GPT-6.1 Sol (max). xhigh nearly doubles output tokens compared with high for a 3 point gain in Intelligence, and Cost per Task falls from $3.16 at xhigh to $1.87 at high. Medium ($0.80) and low ($0.29) cost less again, but score 41 and 27 on the Intelligence Index

On the Time per Task vs. Intelligence Pareto frontier: Gemini 4 Hydrogen has an output speed of ~200 output tokens per second. With high, medium, and low reasoning effort, Gemini 4 Hydrogen is on the Time per Task vs. Intelligence Pareto frontier, meaning no models are both more intelligent and have a lower Time per Task
Key model details:
Context Window: 1M tokens
Multimodality: Text, image, video, and speech input, with text output
Reasoning efforts: Gemini 4 Hydrogen offers four reasoning levels (low, medium, high, and xhigh) with xhigh new in this release
Pricing: $1.50/$7.50 per 1M input/output tokens. Cached input tokens receive a 95% discount ($0.075)
